CANDIDATE_METHOD_RECOMMENDATION: NO_FINAL_METHOD_SELECTION; first define support-constrained structured syntax, then compare conditional designs; researcher owns method decision

conditional_hierarchical_categorical_cem.combinatorial_scalability: reduces impossible products but sequence space remains large
conditional_hierarchical_categorical_cem.compatibility: can encode eligibility and family coupling
conditional_hierarchical_categorical_cem.required_assumptions: causal conditioning variables, conditional order and support policy are frozen
conditional_hierarchical_categorical_cem.scientific_risk: modeling choices can encode untested assumptions
conditional_hierarchical_categorical_cem.train_support_fidelity: closer to observed conditional support, not proven until policy is specified

exact_structured_enumeration.combinatorial_scalability: anchor/horizon counts grow rapidly; no universal feasibility conclusion
exact_structured_enumeration.compatibility: fits typed action rows and explicit support constraints
exact_structured_enumeration.required_assumptions: candidate grammar and eligibility are frozen and enumerable
exact_structured_enumeration.scientific_risk: omits useful but unobserved legal compositions

independent_factorized_categorical_cem.combinatorial_scalability: compact parameterization but combinations grow exponentially
independent_factorized_categorical_cem.required_assumptions: family independence or acceptable measured approximation
independent_factorized_categorical_cem.scientific_risk: creates unsupported co-occurrences; evidence does not support independence

support_aware_random_search.combinatorial_scalability: linear in rollout budget, though coverage can be poor
support_aware_random_search.required_assumptions: sampling distribution and support admission are explicit
support_aware_random_search.scientific_risk: stochastic coverage variance and sampler bias
support_aware_random_search.train_support_fidelity: depends on selected tier and sampler
